evals.prompt: Write an Exact Python model that picks integer quantities of two products to maximise profit under two resource limits, and check the status is proven optimal.
evals.expected_output: A model using setObjective with minimize=False and toOptimum, which reports SAT only as a proven optimum and flips the sign of the maximised value
assertions: Uses Exact's addVariable, addConstraint and setObjective
Reads the value from toOptimum and negates it for a maximisation
Accepts only the SAT state as a proven optimum

evals.prompt: Enumerate every solution of a small Exact model, without counting auxiliary variables twice.
evals.expected_output: A runFull(optimize=False) loop with invalidateLastSol over the declared variables only
assertions: Blocks solutions with invalidateLastSol(names) on the declared variables

evals.prompt: Enumerate all optimal solutions of a 0/1 selection model with Exact.
evals.expected_output: Solve for the optimum, pin the objective at that value, then enumerate
assertions: Pins the real objective terms at the optimum with addConstraint
Enumerates with invalidateLastSol over the decision variables

evals.prompt: Model 'either x is at most 3 or at least 8' in Exact.
evals.expected_output: Two reified switch variables and a disjunction
assertions: Uses addReification or addLeftReification/addRightReification with a head variable
Requires one of the switches to hold
